reference_items.figure_description:
Six 2D polygon outlines arranged in two rows of three:
- Top row:
  - P: a scalene triangle with a horizontal base.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 2-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it. The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration. Use them to place this item.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 2-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it. The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration. Use them to place this item.

step1.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 2-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data". What is the item's step 1 parameter d1? In the GPCM, b - d1 is the ability at which earning the first point becomes more likely than earning no point, so a higher d1 means that this point is earned at a lower ability; the steps sum to 0. Choose the value closest to it. The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration. Use them to place this item.
